what: Heading letters resolve from a 20px blur and transparency in .8s power2.out (.02s stagger per letter, once when the head reaches 80% of the screen). 3s after they have all resolved, a 5px blur wave passes line by line, each letter delayed .12s after the one to its left — one letter blurs over the first 28% with sine.in and clears over the remaining 72% with power1.out, across 2.1s. One cycle is 5s and repeats, pausing when off screen.

options.blur-in · dur · each · delay: Focus-in blur (px) · duration · per-letter stagger · delay, default 20·.8·.02·0
options.blur · letter · step · loop · rest: Wave blur (px) · letter length · letter delay · wheel length · pause before first wave (s), defaults 5 · 2.1 · .12 · 5 · 3
options.on: If load, runs as soon as it attaches — default is when scrolled into view
options.[data-fx-part=line]: (If present) rows — each row waves separately from the left

use: Who do you wantto be today?
